subject: general
question: In which of the following cities of British India was Lata Mangeshkar born?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar**, the legendary** Indian playback singer,** was born in **Indore**, which is now a part of the Indian state of** Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• She is regarded as one of the **most talented** and **well-known singers** from the Indian subcontinent.
 
• She died on **6 February 2022.**
 
• Indore was a princely state under** British India** and was a part of the **Central Provinces and Berar province.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bombay** (now Mumbai) is the birthplace of many **Bollywood actors and actresses**, including Kareena Kapoor.
 
• **Calcutta **(now Kolkata) was the **capital of British India** until **1911 **and is known for its rich cultural heritage, including literature, music, and cinema.
 
• **Lucknow**, the capital of the Indian state of** Uttar Pradesh**, is known for its **Mughal and British-era architecture and cuisine**.
